One Loudoun · Ashburn, Virginia

Running & walkingshoe store inAshburn, VA

=PR= Run & Walk One Loudoun is a family-owned running and walking shoe store at 20436 Exchange St. in Ashburn, Virginia, in the One Loudoun town center. Walk in for a free 3D foot scan and gait analysis, usually about 20 minutes, with no appointment needed. We’re open seven days a week, and we fit runners and walkers of every level, with a focus on performance and trail shoes.

About the One Loudoun store

Born in Loudoun, still running here

=PR= Run & Walk started in Ashburn in 2003, so Loudoun County is where it all began. The One Loudoun store is our home base for runners and walkers in the area, and in 2023 it moved across the street into a larger space of about 2,000 square feet.

Come in with a marathon goal, a nagging heel, a first-ever 5K, or a pair of walking shoes that finally need replacing. We’ll listen first, then show you what fits. If nothing on the wall is right for your feet, we’ll tell you that too.

We were named the 2024 Running Store of the Year by The Running Event, and we try to earn it again every time someone walks through the door.

Shoe fitting in Ashburn, VA

The =PR= fit process

Every pair on our wall is one we’d run or walk in ourselves. The trick is matching your feet, your stride, and your miles to the pair that earns its keep. Here’s how a fitting works at the One Loudoun store.

See the full fit process
1
5 minutes

The conversation

What you’re training for, what’s been bothering you, and what you wear when you’re not running. We listen first, so every recommendation is built around you.

2
Free

3D foot scan

Length, width, arch height, and pressure points, captured in under a minute. We keep the data on file, so your next visit picks up where this one left off.

3
On the treadmill

Gait analysis

A short walk or jog, a slow-motion replay, and a plain-English explanation of how your foot lands and rolls. You leave with a shortlist that makes sense for how you move.

4
Your call

Try and compare

The best way to choose a shoe is to feel the difference. You’ll try two or three pairs, sometimes more, until one feels right for your feet, goals, and lifestyle.

See the full fit process No appointment needed. Just walk in.

Running in Ashburn

Where to run near Ashburn

One Loudoun puts you close to some of Loudoun County’s best runs and walks. Here are three local favorites, and what to know about the ground under your shoes.

Paved

W&OD Trail

A 45-mile paved rail trail that runs through Ashburn, so you can stack up flat, car-free miles in either direction. Road shoes are all you need.

Dirt trail

Beaverdam Reservoir loop

A loop of roughly seven to eight miles around the reservoir on dirt trail marked with blue blazes. After rain, a trail shoe with more grip (the bumpy tread on the bottom) keeps you steady.

Natural surface

Banshee Reeks Nature Preserve

A nature preserve with natural-surface trails, a good change of pace from pavement. Trail shoes are the better call here.

Distances vary a little by source and by the route you pick, so treat them as ballparks. Ask the One Loudoun team which route fits your pace and the shoes you’re wearing.

Community

Run and walk with your neighbors

The One Loudoun store has hosted community events, including the =PR= Birthday Bash 5K and group walks like Stride Into Fall. Whether you’re starting from the couch or training for a half marathon, there’s a group and a start line for you.

Ask the team which group runs are meeting this season, or explore =PR= Training, =PR= Races, and our events list to find your next goal.

One Loudoun store FAQs

No. Walk-ins are welcome at every =PR= store, including One Loudoun. A fitting takes about 20 minutes on average, so give yourself a little extra time if you want to try several pairs.

Nothing. The 3D foot scan, gait analysis, and fitting are free, and if nothing in the store is right for your feet, we’ll say so.

Yes. In late 2023 the store moved across the street into a larger space of about 2,000 square feet. It’s still on Exchange Street at Brimfield Drive in the One Loudoun town center.
